section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1967
title: On an average 58.3% of suicides are committed by males while persons in the age group of 18 to 30 years are more prone to commit suicides and they accounted for 42.9% of the total suicidal deaths during 1967. Among the causes of suicides, despair over dreadful diseases was one of the major causes accounting for 17.2% of total suicidal deaths while quarrel between married partners or parents-in-law together caused 16.3% of the total suicides. Table 7 furnishes statistics of incidence of suicides due to various causes. TABLE-7 Incidence of suicides in India by different causes during 1567
